second_wrapper_audit.evidence: initialize() constructs exactly one TrafficManagerSession (explicit port, explicit seed from the governed seed tree, strict from UP_THESIS_STRICT) and calls session.acquire(client); it does not call client.get_trafficmanager itself, does not set synchronous_mode itself, and does not seed itself

explicit_tm_owner.mechanism: class-level _masters registry keyed by tm_port with claim_master/release_master; a second session on the same port raises

explicit_tm_port.mechanism: tm_port is a required constructor argument; client.get_trafficmanager(self.tm_port) is the only acquisition call

explicit_seed.mechanism: seed=None causes acquire() to raise TRAFFIC_MANAGER_SEED_MISSING before touching the server; set_random_device_seed failure raises TRAFFIC_MANAGER_SETUP_FAILED

strict_mode_fail_closed.mechanism: acquire() has no unbound fallback; it raises on get_trafficmanager failure, None handle, or seed failure. enable_autopilot in strict mode raises TRAFFIC_MANAGER_SETUP_FAILED when no TM is acquired, instead of silently returning attached=False

no_silent_unbound_autopilot.mechanism: autopilot is only ever attached via actor.set_autopilot(True, self.tm_port) after an acquired TM; non-strict callers get an explicit diagnostic reason TRAFFIC_MANAGER_UNAVAILABLE

owned_vehicles_and_controllers.mechanism: ScenarioActorRegistry.register(kind, actor) for every owned actor; NEW-330 exists because ScenarioManager.create_anomalies spawned a stopped vehicle directly via world.try_spawn_actor without registering it

cleanup_verification.mechanism: destroy_all() reports destroyed/survivors/errors; verify_clean() returns clean=False with a failure code listing any actor whose is_alive() is still true

stationary_actors_not_reported_as_active.mechanism: validate_walker_mode(entries, mode=...) rejects WALKER_UNCONTROLLED for a static walker claiming counts_as_pedestrian_traffic, for an unknown mode, for a controlled walker without a controller_actor_id, and for controlled mode with zero controlled walkers

world_tm_sync_consistency.mechanism: validate_world_tm_sync rejects a synchronous world driven by an asynchronous TM

double_tick_ownership.mechanism: verified via an exclusive ticker in the negative controls (test_double_tick_ownership_is_rejected). Note: this is demonstrated against an explicit single-owner ticker contract rather than a production class; the per-frame controller is single-instance by construction (one DeterministicWeatherController owns its frame index).
